message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  The most reliable way to get the current U.S. gold price is to check a reputable financial news source or market data platform such as:

| Source | Typical URL / App |
|--------|-------------------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com |
| CNBC | https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/XAUUSD |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |

These sites update the spot price (usually quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce) every few seconds during trading hours. If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also search “gold price” on Google or use a finance app on your phone; the result will typically show the latest spot price along with a short‑term chart.

If you need historical data or want to see how the price has moved over a specific period, most of those platforms let you download daily closing prices or view interactive charts.
